island.title: The Long Night
island.rule: Brass Toll Scales let you sell the game's own settings, like hearts, map, color, or sound, for lantern power, and the island reacts to every choice.
island.feel: Wistful, strange, and mythic as each sacrifice strips the screen down to pure aim while fueling your lantern.
island.arc: Make your first setting trade at Vigil Terrace, clear the Toll House, Archive of Lost Lamps, and Endless Stair to break the Triple Eclipse Seal, ascend the Bell Sanctum, and face the Hush with a final choice.
moments: Making your first trade pulls motes straight out of the display into your lantern as twin eclipse bridges light up.
Standing in the mezzanine where selling color exposes a hidden four-color mural concealed inside full-color light.
The Tollmaster pauses mid-fight with an invoice, daring you to sell a setting or smash his register in time.
Seeing a silent vision of Hollow Wick refusing a golden Toll Scale, then reading his final note before the Hush.
Facing the final choice at the Hush: sell the screen itself for one last blast, or refuse and stand unbroken.

toll_house.promise: A counting house built like a settings menu, where scales, organs, and vaults reward both pure aim and whatever settings you chose to sell.
toll_house.power: Brass Receipt stamps thrown lanterns onto plates to hold weight for six seconds.
toll_house.arc: Crosses the Interface Wing to earn the Brass Receipt from the Chief Auditor, puts weight stamps to work through the Feel Wing, peaks in a four-color mezzanine and mute organ loft, and ends at the Basilica.
toll_house.boss: The Tollmaster tests mirror banks behind his lectern and mid-fight invoices to sell a setting or smash his register.

archive.promise: A grand library holding eight remixed memories of every island's rules, building toward Hollow Wick's untold refusal and a borrowed-boss finale.
archive.power: Bookmark Sigil pins fading timers, plants, roses, and lantern hooks longer.
archive.arc: Replays Islands one through four in the lower stacks before the Indexer grants the Bookmark Sigil, then remixes Islands five through eight culminating in lending away your own moves on memory plinths.
archive.boss: The Archivist cycles three chapters of earlier Keepers, testing mirrors, Dusk Bells, and full-kit counters.

endless_stair.promise: A twelve-floor spiral climb through shifting encounter pools where each cleared floor offers a choice of three temporary blessings.
endless_stair.arc: Climbs through three tiers of randomized arenas with Express Lift checkpoints at floors four, eight, and twelve, a quiet sky balcony midway, and a three-terrace scramble right before the summit.
endless_stair.boss: The Stair Warden returns on floors four, eight, and twelve with lunges, mirror lances, and crumbling treads.

bell_sanctum.promise: A ruined gothic cathedral uniting every island's moves and rules across twin wings before a grand eclipse bell and the final duel with the Hush.
bell_sanctum.arc: Branches from the narthex through a shadow-scale west wing and stained-glass east wing past two mini-bosses, merges inside an eight-move belfry contraption, and pauses at a quiet threshold before the Hush.
bell_sanctum.boss: The Hush spans four phases pairing every island's rules, reacting to sold settings, and ending in a final choice.

overworld.aha: The central spine tests foes from every past island and fans out to all four districts of the Long Night.
checks: Did facing familiar enemies from earlier islands feel like a homecoming?
